status: DECIDED per D-025/026/027 (2026-10-11). MPNs selected by primary source; footprints still to audit before G3; LCSC/stock/price TBD. NOT a purchase, NOT a gate sign-off.

D301_D302_rectifier.requirement: VRRM >= 400 V (2x margin over 102.1 V PIV), IF(AV) >= 6 A, IFSM >= 200 A, CT full-wave 2 diodes

candidates.source: reference/parts/onsemi-mur3020wtg.pdf (MUR3020WT/D Rev.7 Jul-2014 p.1 Max Ratings)
candidates.verdict: PASS all requirements (VRRM 400>=400, IF(AV) 15>=6, IFSM 200>=200). Confirm 400 V variant picks the 200 A IFSM leg (600 V leg is 150 A). Tab/DPAK package; footprint/thermal not yet selected.
candidates.open: PIV worst case 102.1 V at 133 VAC gives 3.9x margin; verify derating at real case temp; footprint audit pending

candidates.source: distributor page (hotenda) citing ST datasheet; NOT archived locally
candidates.verdict: FAIL: IFSM 120 A < 200 A required. Rejected; listed to document the rejection.

D301_D302_rectifier.recommendation: MUR3040WTG (400 V variant) meets all D-021 diode requirements with margin; footprint/thermal derating still to audit before any board commit.
D301_D302_rectifier.decision: D-025: MUR3040WTG x2 (VRRM 400V, IF(AV) 15A @145C, IFSM 200A). Footprint TO-247/DPAK to audit.

C301_C302_bulk.requirement: 2 x 4700 uF/63 V/105 C, ripple >= 3.5 A RMS @120 Hz per piece (D-021), total ~12.4 mF with core caps

findings.verdict: FAIL: UHE 63 V line tops out at 1500 uF; no 4700 uF/63 V.
FAIL: max 2200 uF (not 4700) and ripple 1.61 A < 3.5 A required.

C301_C302_bulk.analysis: The D-021 target of 2 x 4700 uF/63 V with >=3.5 A rms/120 Hz is not met by any 63 V aluminum electrolytic in the local reference set. 4700 uF is common at <=35 V but not at 63 V; high-ripple 63 V parts of that capacitance need low-ESR snap-in types (e.g. Panasonic EEU-EB1J) NOT in the local set. Ripple current and capacitance/voltage trade against each other in Al electrolytics.
C301_C302_bulk.severity: RESOLVED (D-025): Rubycon 63USC4700MEFCSN30X30 selected; footprint snap-in D30 still to audit
tbd: Source low-ESR 63 V snap-in electrolytics (Panasonic EEU-EB, Rubycon, Nichicon HE/PW) with 4700 uF and ripple >=3.5 A @120 Hz
Confirm ripple: D-021 estimates ~6.7 A rms bank at 3.9 A continuous; per-cap >=3.5 A @120 Hz may need >=18 mm can
Or revisit budget: 2 x 2200 uF may suffice if ripple relaxed; re-run D-021 ngspice
Endurance 105 C, ESR, aging/temperature derating, frequency coefficient TBD
C301_C302_bulk.recommendation: Do NOT pick a bulk MPN yet. Re-open the capacitance/ripple requirement: find a 63 V low-ESR 4700 uF snap-in (>=18 mm) or reduce per-cap ripple need. Needs owner input on can size vs OEM envelope.
C301_C302_bulk.decision: Rubycon 63USC4700MEFCSN30X30 x2 (LCSC C1498587): 4700uF/63V, 3.49A rms @120Hz, D30xL30, 3000h @85C. Footprint CP_Radial D30 snap-in to audit; Nichicon UHE/Panasonic NHG-A had no 4700uF/63V.

D303_tvs.requirement: VWM >= 51 V, Vc < 69 V (below TPA3255 absolute max) at specified pulse

candidates.verdict: FAIL: Vc 82.4 V >= 69 V required. Clamping exceeds TPA3255 53.5 V absolute max by a wide margin.

D303_tvs.analysis: Standard TVS families (SMCJ/SMBJ) clamp ~1.6x VWM; for VWM 51 V, Vc ~82 V is inherent. Vc < 69 V at meaningful current needs a higher-power part, bidirectional/series scheme, or an active crowbar. The D-021 Vc<69 V requirement is likely physically incompatible with a simple 51 V standoff TVS.
D303_tvs.severity: RESOLVED (D-026): Vc<69V infeasible with passive 51V TVS; OVP by TPS3700 sustained window + SMCJ51A as energy absorber
tbd: Re-evaluate feasibility of Vc<69 V: higher-power SMC (clamp at larger Ipp), MOV+TVS hybrid, or active OVP/crowbar via the TPS3700 OV window already captured
Confirm actual transient energy and required Vc at that current
D-021 already notes TVS covers fast transient; sustained OVP is the TPS3700 OV (50.97-52.24 V)
D303_tvs.recommendation: TVS selection BLOCKED by a requirement conflict. Revisit Vc<69 V spec vs the sustained TPS3700 OVP before selecting. Do not force SMCJ51A (fails Vc).
D303_tvs.decision: Keep SMCJ51A (VWM 51V, Vc 82.4V) as fast-transient energy absorber only. Primary OVP = TPS3700 window 50.97-52.24V (sustained). Do NOT rely on TVS clamp.

F301_fuse.requirement: Slow-blow (time-lag), I2t > 63.6 A^2s margin, >= 63 VDC, in CT return before GND (D-021)
F301_fuse.note: D-021 defers inrush strategy: decide NTC or bypass relay after measuring real I2t of mains fuse T2.5AL and bench start current. No fuse MPN selected without bench data.
tbd: Measure real inrush I2t on bench (D-021 estimated 45-169 A peak, I2t <= 63.6 A^2s first 100 ms)
Select fuse with I2t melt above measured inrush but below transformer/bulk damage threshold
Confirm voltage rating (63 VDC min) and time-lag curve
F301_fuse.recommendation: TBD - blocked on bench measurement. Candidate family (not selected): 5x20 mm time-lag T series (Littelfuse 218/892). No MPN committed.
F301_fuse.decision: D-027: time-lag (T) 5x20mm >=63VDC; rating by operating RMS (~4.3-5.7A) not inrush. Family Littelfuse 218/892. Exact I2t/ampere after BENCH-001.

J301_J302_connector.requirement: T1 secondary interface, ~4 mm pitch, 20 AWG wire (J301); JST VH family per D-021

candidates.family: JST VH (3.96 mm Disconnectable Crimp style)
candidates.verdict: PASS: pitch 3.96 mm ~= 4 mm, 20 AWG in range, 10 A rating. Terminal SVH-41T-P1.1; housing VHR-4N.
candidates.open: J301 is 3-position (T1 redA/blackCT/redB); confirm circuit count and header (B3P-VH / VHR-3N). Header/housing MPN TBD.

J301_J302_connector.recommendation: JST VH SVH-41T-P1.1 terminals fit 20 AWG/3.96 mm; header/housing part number and exact circuit count TBD pending T1 pinout confirmation.

inrush_strategy.requirement: decide NTC vs bypass relay (D-021 item 1)
inrush_strategy.note: Deferred by D-021 pending bench measurement of T2.5AL mains fuse I2t and actual start current.

analysis.inrush_peak_a: 45-169 A (D-021 ngspice, liga no pico, bulk 0 V)
options: NTC inrush limiter in series before bulk - simple, steady-state power loss and thermal; size for 3.9 A load
Bypass relay closing after precharge - efficient steady state, adds relay + control (sequencer D-020 could drive it)
analysis.recommendation: Defer to bench. Do not select NTC or relay without measured inrush. Sequencer D-020/D-023 already provides hold/timing to gate a bypass relay.

inrush_strategy.decision: D-027: handled by time-lag fuse; NTC+relay rejected (NTC I2R loss at 3.9A; relay 17x23mm no room). Matches original board approach.

summary_findings: C301/C302: DECIDED Rubycon 63USC4700MEFCSN30X30 x2 (D-025); snap-in footprint to audit.
D303 TVS: DECIDED by architecture (D-026) - OVP via TPS3700 sustained window; SMCJ51A energy absorber only (Vc 82.4V infeasible as clamp).
F301 fuse: DECIDED time-lag by operating RMS (D-027); exact I2t/ampere after bench.
Inrush: DECIDED via time-lag fuse, no NTC/relay (D-027).
J301/J302: JST VH SVH-41T-P1.1 fits 20 AWG/3.96mm; housing/header MPN TBD.
